scope_note: Controlled synchronous text segments with oracle endpoint acceptance; not real ASR, online TTS, acoustic playback, or production end-to-end latency.

design.oracle_latency_lower_bound_metric: TTFT_eff from endpoint_accept_ns; survived candidates are set to zero
design.endpoint_note: For System B endpoint acceptance occurs after final-segment prefill/trigger/candidate processing, not immediately at final segment arrival.

e1.primary_comparison: System A minus B@0.92 arrival-to-first-token-ready, paired within session and dialogue

primary_paired.relative_denominator: condition_a arrival_to_first_token_ready; zero-denominator pairs are excluded

oracle_ttft_eff_latency_lower_bound_pair.relative_denominator: condition_a oracle_ttft_eff_latency_lower_bound; zero-denominator pairs are excluded

e2.primary_comparison: never_speculate minus B@0.92 arrival-to-first-token-ready, paired within session and dialogue

primary_paired.relative_denominator: condition_a arrival_to_first_token_ready; zero-denominator pairs are excluded

oracle_ttft_eff_latency_lower_bound_pair.relative_denominator: condition_a oracle_ttft_eff_latency_lower_bound; zero-denominator pairs are excluded

bootstrap.method: percentile two-level bootstrap: session then dialogue within drawn session
